identity.title: List of Magical Pokémon Journey chapters

leadText: This is a list of chapters in the Magical Pokémon Journey manga series created by Yumi Tsukirino. Altogether, there are 69 regular chapters, 20 bonus chapters and 2 appendix chapters.
